name: ATRD Strategy
description: Strategy for the Air Transport Research and Development symposium. Overrides the fetch step to scrape paper metadata directly from the ATRD symposium papers-and-presentations page via the searcher /search_atrd_papers endpoint. The per-year URL is taken from the venue's download_sources entry whose name matches the target year.

steps.name: Fetch ATRD Papers
steps.description: Call GET /search_atrd_papers with the ATRD symposium papers-and-presentations page URL for the target year. Returns paper metadata including title, authors, section, best-paper flag, and Google Drive PDF link.

config.notes: The url param must be the ATRD symposium papers-and-presentations page for the target year, taken from the venue's download_sources list. Response fields: title, authors, section, is_best_paper, full_paper_url, presentation_url.

steps.name: Generate Synthetic DOI
steps.description: ATRD papers are not registered with DOI.org. Generate a deterministic synthetic DOI for any paper that lacks one, derived from the venue slug, year, and slugified title.

config.notes: Generated DOI format: 10.0000/<namespace>.<year>.<title_slug>. doi_synthetic is set to true on all generated DOIs.

steps.name: Download PDFs
steps.description: POST each paper record to /download_atrd_paper on the searcher. The endpoint returns the raw PDF bytes. The file is saved to pdf/<venue_slug>/<year>/<title_slug>.pdf and pdf_path on the paper record is updated.

config.notes: Response is application/pdf binary. Filename derived from title_slug. Skips papers that already have a pdf_path set. concurrency controls max simultaneous PDF downloads.

steps.name: Build BibTeX Entry
steps.description: Assemble a BibTeX @inproceedings entry for each paper using all available metadata. booktitle comes from venue_long, address and month from the download_sources entry for the target year.

config.notes: Omits fields that are empty. doi_synthetic=true is recorded in the note field.

steps.name: Upsert to Library
steps.description: Upsert each paper into the MongoDB paper library after PDF download and BibTeX generation are complete.

config.notes: Runs per-paper in the background download loop. Existing records are updated only for fields returned by the searcher; existing fields not in the response are preserved.
